ui_bugs.issue: Share button did NOT flip to 'copied' state after click in Playwright headless (text stayed 'Challenge a friend'). Likely because navigator.clipboard.writeText() silently rejects without a granted clipboard-write permission in headless Chromium. Real browsers should work, but recommend adding a graceful fallback (execCommand or visible state flip regardless of clipboard promise result) so the confirmation UX is deterministic across environments.

Weekly leaderboard uses ISO-week key (week_key) computed at insertion time; historical rows keep their original week so scope filter is deterministic and time-travel safe.
personal_best is a MAX aggregation across runs, not a stored counter - regression-safe (verified by test_best_score_is_max_not_latest).
